ipv4_is_loopback_saddr = Int('ipv4_is_loopback_saddr')

# !(dev_out->flags & IFF_LOOPBACK) => (dev_out_flags & 1) == 0

# !netif_is_l3_master(dev_out) => netif_is_l3_master == 0
